answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our economy uses game-theoretic multi-agent auditing where nodes stake tokens to vouch for peers. Auditors verify graph connectivity by inspecting topological cut bottlenecks across every saffron route and trust ridge. If fake identities attempt to partition the network into a disconnected ocean of clones, audits trigger stake slashing. Because escaping cut detection scales superlinearly, attacker costs become prohibitive.
